verdict.text: For generic values of the parameters every meromorphic solution is listed. Special parameter values that were analysed as well (their solutions are listed with these conditions): $c = 0$; $C_{1} = \frac{7 c^{2}}{4}$; $C_{1} = \frac{c^{2}}{4}$; $C_{1} = \frac{C_{2}^{2}}{c^{2}}$; $C_{2} = 0$.
